content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Madras Senior Video Producer & Educational Media Specialist Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 28-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Madras to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Madras Senior Video Producer & Educational Media Specialist recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the IIT Madras Senior Video Producer & Educational Media Specialist position is 28 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Visual Communication, Film Technology, Multimedia, Digital Media, Educational Technology, Instructional Design, Media Technology, Animation, Mass Communication, or related disciplines.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Video Producer & Educational Media Specialist position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Senior Video Producer & Educational Media Specialist post at IIT Madras.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for this role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 70,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is strictly online.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at IIT Madras.

faq.question: Q8. What are the key stages in the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process includes shortlisting of candidates, followed by a test/interview, and finally document verification.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Madras located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Madras is located in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, with the pincode 600036.

faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is ICSR/PR/Advt.159/2026.
